notes: Official Devin CLI docs are the source of truth.
.devin/hooks.v1.json is the recommended project-level standalone hooks file.
In .devin/hooks.v1.json, the hooks object is the entire file and is not nested under a hooks key.
Command hooks receive JSON on stdin and may return JSON decisions on stdout.

Field-verified 2026-06-12 (v2026.5.26-8): Devin parses non-empty stdout strictly as Claude-format JSON. Plain text fails the effects evaluator and is silently dropped, with only a 'Failed to parse Claude hook output' warning in the CLI logs. Scripts must emit empty stdout or one valid JSON object.
SessionStart context injection uses the Claude shape: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "..."}}.
Devin renders no hook activity in its TUI and does not display systemMessage as of v2026.5.26-8. Verify hooks via /hooks, the CLI logs, or the session transcript JSON.
DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR is automatically set to the project root directory.
Exit code 2 blocks or denies the action. Other non-zero exits are logged but do not block.
Matchers are regexes over tool_name and are meaningful for PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and PermissionRequest.
The lifecycle page documents PostCompaction even though the overview event table omits it.

events.name: PreToolUse
events.description: Runs before a tool executes and can block, modify, or add context to tool calls.
events.blocking_guidance: Use exit code 2 for hard safety and policy gates before the tool runs.

events.name: PostToolUse
events.description: Runs after a tool finishes for logging, validation, or follow-up actions.
events.blocking_guidance: Usually keep observer behavior non-blocking unless the plan explicitly sets block_on_failure.

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.description: Runs when the agent needs a permission decision.
events.blocking_guidance: Use stdout decisions for approvals or denials and exit code 2 for intentional denials.

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.description: Runs when the user submits a message.
events.blocking_guidance: Use cautiously for prompt policy or context injection; non-tool event matchers should be empty or omitted.

events.name: Stop
events.description: Runs when the agent decides to stop its turn.
events.blocking_guidance: Use exit code 2 to prevent premature stopping, but check stop_hook_active to avoid loops.

events.name: PostCompaction
events.description: Runs after context compaction completes successfully.
events.blocking_guidance: Prefer non-blocking logging or context repair after compaction.

events.name: SessionStart
events.description: Runs when a new session begins.
events.blocking_guidance: Use for initialization, logging, or environment setup; block only if setup is mandatory. To inject context, emit hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext JSON; plain-text stdout is silently dropped.
